title: AgentToolPolicy.v1
description: The tool-governance contract for an agent run on the shared plane. Deny-by-default: a tool must appear in allowlist to be invokable, and a tool in denylist is rejected even if also allowlisted (denylist wins). requires_sandbox forces tool execution inside the sandbox boundary; elevated_requires_approval forces a human approval (HumanApprovalReceipt) before any elevated/host-affecting tool runs. The agent never grants itself a tool — the policy is set by Baltor, the agent only PROPOSES within it.

allowlist.description: tool ids the agent MAY invoke; anything not listed is denied (deny-by-default)

denylist.description: tool ids explicitly forbidden; denylist takes precedence over allowlist

requires_sandbox.description: when true, every allowed tool must execute inside the sandbox boundary (no direct host execution)

elevated_requires_approval.description: when true, any elevated/host-affecting tool requires a human approval before it runs
